name: 32966 · Vero Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 32966 (Vero Beach) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32966 (Vero Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
